The rust texture appears somewhat 'painted on' or noisy rather than physically accumulated. There are strange colorful speckles (blue/green) that don't align with typical iron oxidation patterns, suggesting hallucinated texture details.
The geometry of the links becomes inconsistent; some rings appear to change thickness abruptly or lose their circular cross-section, looking more like amorphous blobs than rigid metal rings.
